checks: The completed inbound request opens its actual Telegram conversation and receipt-backed result; portal task injection has no input.
The real conversation list filters Telegram contexts through the public contract.
A separate administrator session saves the explicit default task but cannot read the requester’s conversation.
The real automatic dispatcher converts repeated webhook delivery into one durable run; a changed channel revision gets a new context.
The original requester cancels the actual queued run in the UI, and the Telegram receipt displays the committed cancelled state.
A real group membership loss withdraws active work and records the channel revision while preserving the previously completed result.
The UI states that task completion does not mean Telegram delivery; the test invokes neither a provider nor Telegram outbound.
scope: Web with real native API and committed business events
